name: Noir Mystery: Location Interior
description: Image preset for a location interior in the Noir Mystery look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for an interior. List the room's purpose, three props that say who uses it, and the light source from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: interior view of the location from a doorway or corner, key furniture and props in place, light source visible, room for characters to stand, film noir still, hard chiaroscuro, venetian-blind shadows across the face, rain-slick streets, fedoras and trench coats, cigarette smoke, black and white or heavily desaturated, single hard key light, deep blacks, wet reflective surfaces
negative_prompt: bright saturated colour, sunny daylight, modern technology, cartoon, cheerful mood, text, watermark
